title: Structured Constraint
description: REFERENCE-TASK-000014: a single machine-readable predicate, replacing the free-text constraint strings and validation.yaml `expression` strings WORK_PACKAGE_001 used. Reused via $ref from properties.schema.json, relationships.schema.json, behaviors.schema.json, and validation.schema.json (which adds rule_id/severity on top of this same shape).

subject.description: What this constraint applies to -- a property_id, a behavior input/output variable name, or "self" for a whole-object/relationship constraint.

operator.description: gt/gte/lt/lte/eq/neq compare `subject` against `operand`. not_null and not_empty are unary and ignore `operand`.

operand.description: Required for binary operators (gt/gte/lt/lte/eq/neq); omitted or null for unary operators (not_null/not_empty).

description.description: Human-readable explanation, generated from or alongside the structured fields -- never authoritative on its own (SDD-R011 §10: "Human-readable validation text shall not be authoritative").
